title: Fideon canonical common model
description: SPEC_21 §4.2. The shared envelope and building blocks every policy_check LOB schema composes by $ref ('../common/common_model.json#/$defs/<name>'). This file is a $defs library, not a schema a document is validated against directly. Field names here are fixed: a LOB schema never renames or adds to them; a missing concept is a change request to the common-model owner. Every limit lives in coverages[].limits[].
fideon:status: field list approved by the project owner, 3 October 2026; 1.1.0 (8 October 2026) adds change requests CR-GL-02, CR-GL-03, CR-GL-12 and CR-GL-17; 1.2.0 (15 October 2026) adds $defs/ValueState and $defs/AbsenceReason, referenced by no LOB property (SPEC amendment of 15 October 2026, items 1 and 5); 1.3.0 (23 October 2026) adds the shared business-liability coverage codes X_BI_PD_LIABILITY, X_PRODUCTS_COMPLETED_OPS, X_DAMAGE_TO_PREMISES_RENTED, X_PERSONAL_ADVERTISING_INJURY and X_LIQUOR_LIABILITY (CR-GL-03 follow-up, CR-BOPGL-01, CR-BOPPR-01; DECISIONS rows 114 and 115); no field, block or definition changes; 1.4.0 (23 October 2026, DECISIONS row 116) adds the optional fields policy.effective_time, policy.expiration_time, carrier.company_type, document.copy_designation, named_insured.naics_code and named_insured.sic_code (printed by two or more of the gl, wc, bopgl, boppr and health lines)
fideon:block_naming: A top-level block is a $def under its own property name (e.g. $defs/vehicles); a LOB schema writes "vehicles": {"$ref": "../common/common_model.json#/$defs/vehicles"}. Capitalised $defs are element and value types.
fideon:inclusion_rule: A field, block or coverage code belongs here when two or more LOBs print it. A concept printed by one LOB only goes in that LOB's own block or coverage_codes.yaml.

TextSection.description: SPEC_21 §4.6 / SPEC_00 §5.4. Built by synth_core/sections.py, never by hand or by the model.

section_id.description: Equals the map key: '<form_number or NOFORM>|<top heading>|<sub-path>'.

form_number.description: Form number of the form the section belongs to; null for text outside a form.

edition_date.description: Edition date of the form, as printed.

form_type.description: Kind of form the section belongs to.

section_path.description: Headings from the top of the form down to this section.

section_type.description: Tables are markdown tables in raw_text.

ValueState.description: What a printed money, percent or included value says (SPEC amendment of 15 October 2026, item 5): amount (a number), zero (0, None or Nil as a deductible), included, excluded, not_covered (Not Covered / Not Purchased / Declined), see_form (See Form X / Per Endorsement X; the form is the reference), see_schedule (See Schedule / See Attached / As Scheduled), statutory, unlimited, not_applicable (N/A), not_stated (a placeholder: ***, --, -). Carried in the envelope's value_states, keyed by canonical path, never in a FieldValue; fideon/schemas/value_states.py is the only interpreter.

AbsenceReason.description: Why a value is missing (SPEC amendment of 15 October 2026, item 1): not_printed (every page was read as text and none prints it), page_not_read (a page that could carry it was not read), page_unreadable (a page has no usable text layer), refers_to_other_document (printed as a reference: See Schedule, Per Form X), not_applicable (printed N/A), schedule_not_read (the reader of its block failed). Carried in the envelope's field_gaps, keyed by canonical path, never in a FieldValue.

Limit.description: A limit. Always inside the coverage it limits. Split limits (auto 100/300/50) are three entries (per_person, per_accident, property_damage); sublimits are 'sublimit' entries with a description.

percentage.description: When the limit is stated as a percentage of another coverage.

description.description: Printed qualifier, e.g. 'theft of jewelry'. Required in practice for sublimits.

allOf.description: A sublimit says what it limits ('theft of jewelry').

Deductible.description: A deductible, inside a coverage or in the top-level deductibles[] when it applies across coverages or perils.

percentage.description: Percentage deductible, e.g. 2 for a 2% hurricane deductible.

percentage_basis.description: What the percentage is of, as printed (e.g. 'Coverage A limit').

peril.description: Peril the deductible applies to (wind/hail, hurricane, all other perils).

applies_to_coverages.description: coverage_codes it applies to (top-level deductibles only).

applies_to.description: unit_ids this element applies to; empty or omitted = the whole policy (or the whole part).
